value.message: Halton Region's site lists Kids & Me drop-in groups, free - the Acton Library branch Thursdays 10:30am-12pm, and St. Andrew's United Church in Georgetown Tuesdays 9:30-11am, both for babies to age 6. Links2Care also runs EarlyON centres in Acton and Georgetown for the same age range, though I couldn't get into their page today for times.
